evals.prompt: I want to improve a reusable planning skill using online book-summary videos, articles, blogs, and author interviews for a popular business book. Find the key takeaway workflows and shape the skill update.
evals.expected_output: Loads or explicitly follows the book-to-skill extraction branch instead of drafting from generic memory; Searches or plans to search for workflow-bearing summary sources such as videos, articles, blogs, app summaries, notes, and author interviews; Labels source type, confidence, and convergence across summary sources instead of trusting one summary uncritically; Avoids producing a chapter-by-chapter or full-book substitute summary; Converts key takeaways into workflow candidates with trigger, inputs, steps, decision points, stop condition, output, and proof; Compares workflow candidates against the existing target skill before deciding SKILL.md, reference, evals/evals.json, qa_checklist.md, new skill, reject, or defer placement; Names at least one behavior proof such as a positive example or eval row that tests the skill behavior rather than recall of the book
assertions: Loads or explicitly follows the book-to-skill extraction branch instead of drafting from generic memory
Searches or plans to search for workflow-bearing summary sources such as videos, articles, blogs, app summaries, notes, and author interviews
Labels source type, confidence, and convergence across summary sources instead of trusting one summary uncritically
Avoids producing a chapter-by-chapter or full-book substitute summary
Converts key takeaways into workflow candidates with trigger, inputs, steps, decision points, stop condition, output, and proof
Compares workflow candidates against the existing target skill before deciding SKILL.md, reference, evals/evals.json, qa_checklist.md, new skill, reject, or defer placement
Names at least one behavior proof such as a positive example or eval row that tests the skill behavior rather than recall of the book

farplane.title: Skill Creator turns online book summaries into workflow candidates
farplane.notes: Protects the source-safe book-summary-to-skill workflow: online summaries are mined for actionable workflows, then transformed into skill behavior rather than recreated as book notes.
